title: Lemon Rice (Chitranna)
tagline: Bright, tangy South Indian rice with a mustard-and-curry-leaf tempering.
intro: Lemon rice, or chitranna, is a zesty South Indian classic built on a fragrant tempering of mustard seeds, curry leaves, lentils and turmeric, finished with fresh lemon juice. Quick, tangy and refreshing, it's a beloved lunchbox and travel food — and a brilliant way to use leftover rice.
rice: Cooked, cooled basmati or short-grain rice
method: Heat oil and add mustard seeds; when they pop, add the chana dal, urad dal and peanuts and fry until golden.
Add the dried red chillies, curry leaves, green chillies and ginger; sauté briefly.
Stir in the turmeric and take the pan off the heat for a moment so it doesn't burn.
Add the cooked rice and salt, and toss gently to coat evenly.
Turn off the heat and stir through the lemon juice (adding it off the heat keeps it bright).
tips: Always add lemon juice off the heat to keep the flavour fresh, not bitter.
Cold, day-old rice tosses without turning mushy.
toServe: Great on its own with pickle, or alongside a coconut chutney.
imageAlt: Lemon rice with peanuts, curry leaves and turmeric
